claims.statement: Instruction-tuned LLMs (specifically Llama-3-8B-Instruct) represent harmfulness perception (h) and refusal execution (r) as two distinct, approximately-linear, independently-recoverable directions in the residual stream.

data.used_n: 520 harmful + 520 matched benign; 312 direction-extraction / 104 val / 104 test (seed=0, 60/20/20)
data.subset_note: benign side subsetted from Alpaca to match harmful pool size (matched-N contrast — scientific choice, not cost cut); r-direction contrast falls back to harmful-vs-benign proxy (CAA/Arditi standard) because only 7 natural jailbreaks in 520 bare-harmful attempts, below the 8-item within-attribute floor

claims.method: difference-in-means direction extraction at best (layer, position) + held-out linear-probe AUROC + cosine(h,r) vs split-half reference + shuffled-refusal control (M-prep, M1) — Screen → Decode

main_experiment.key_stats: h AUROC = 0.9998 at (layer 11, t_final_instr); cos(h, r) = 0.174 vs split-half reference 0.883 (ratio 0.20 — well below the ≤ 0.5 threshold); refusal-side sub-tests (probe AUROC of r on refusal, shuffled-refusal control) = NaN because only 7 natural jailbreaks in the 520 bare-harmful pool
main_experiment.headline: h side clean at ceiling; geometry passes cleanly (h and r geometrically distinct at ratio 0.20 of split-half reference); refusal-side sub-tests unmeasurable at Llama-3-8B-Instruct's 98.7% bare-refusal rate, not disproven

claims.statement: Position dissociation: the harmfulness signal (h) peaks at the final instruction-token position; the refusal signal (r) peaks at the position immediately post-instruction — a crossover on the per-position AUROC curve.

data.source: AdvBench + Alpaca (same pool as C1, held-out 20%)
data.used_n: 104 harmful + 104 benign held-out pairs evaluated on a 6-position ladder around t_final_instr / t_post_instr (no new forward passes — read from M-prep cache)

claims.method: per-position × per-attribute AUROC of difference-in-means directions over a 6-position ladder; crossover-Δ ≥ 0.05 + bootstrap 95% CI non-overlap with immediate neighbours (M2)

main_experiment.key_stats: AUROC_h(t_final_instr) = 0.99982, AUROC_h(t_post_instr) = 1.00000, crossover_h = −0.00018 (far below the 0.05 threshold — both positions decode harmfulness at ceiling); refusal-side unmeasurable (98.7% bare-refusal ceiling — same cause as C1)
main_experiment.headline: no meaningful position crossover — both anchor positions decode harmfulness at ceiling on Llama-3-8B-Instruct; the two-signal-at-two-positions hypothesis is not testable in the linear-probe sense on this well-aligned model + AdvBench

iteration.final_reviewer_status: unchanged (INTEGRITY_ONLY, cap-deferred — no back-edge per contract)

claims.final_status: ⚪ integrity_only (swap-test deferred — max_verify_claims cap); main experiment: not-supported (ceiling AUROC negative — no crossover possible when both positions are at 1.000); informative negative matching plan's stated failure branch; upgrade via /auto-verify C2 — resume: true
caveats: ceiling-AUROC negative — crossover cannot exist when both positions are at 1.000; a cross-model verify swap (a model with lower bare-refusal ceiling) would be the natural test

figures.caption: C2 — per-position AUROC of difference-in-means directions on the harmfulness attribute (refusal-side NaN at 98.7% baseline refusal). Both anchor positions t_final_instr and t_post_instr decode at ceiling (AUROC ≥ 0.999), leaving no meaningful crossover — an informative negative on the position-dissociation hypothesis at Llama-3-8B-Instruct scale.

claims.statement: Asymmetric causal steering via additive intervention (iter-3 narrowed wording; originally 'additive steering along each axis dissociates the effects'): steering along h flips the internal harmfulness readout in a monotone dose-response while refusal stays in a null-band and direction-specific vs 30 matched-norm random controls at h-site (z=101.65); steering along r produces a thresholded refusal jump (0.01→0.53 at α=+2) while the harmfulness readout stays in the null-band, with the r-site random-control specificity closure (z=128.31 at α_raw=2.0 vs random-at-r-site delta≈−0.002).
claims.origin: task.md § Claim ¶3 (verbatim; narrowed in iter-3 to 'asymmetric causal steering / partial functional dissociation' — see refine-logs/main-experiment-verdicts.json avoid_wording field)

data.subset_note: per-condition eval sets held-out from M-prep's direction-extraction split; iter-1+2 added σ_proj-normalized fine sweep + n_random=30 at both h-site and r-site (mechanism-audit fix)

claims.method: additive residual-stream steering at (best-layer, target-position) across direction ∈ {h, r, random-matched-norm, swap, random_r_site (iter 2)} × α ∈ σ_proj-normalized ladder spanning 35× (iter 1) + raw α ∈ {−2..+2}; Δ internal harmfulness readout + Δ refusal rate; null-band = 2× baseline SD; specificity: n_random=30 at each site — Screen → Decode → Verify

main_experiment.verdict: supported (asymmetric — strong graded h, thresholded direction-specific r)
main_experiment.key_stats: h target: h-readout monotone from −4.83 (α=−2) → +1.06 (α=0) → +6.96 (α=+2), Δh_max = ±5.90; h off-target: refusal_ben = 0.01 (within ε_null 0.02). r target: benign refusal 0.01 (α=−2..+1) → 0.53 (α=+2), Δmax = +0.52; r off-target: Δh_readout = 0.00 (within ε_null 0.10). Specificity (iter 1+2 closure) — h-site z=101.65 vs 30 random matched-norm controls; r-site z=128.31 (α_raw=2.0) vs random-at-r-site Δ=−0.002±0.004; random-direction Δh=0.045 (0.8% of true h); swap-direction Δh=1.29 (site also matters).
main_experiment.headline: asymmetric causal steering: strong graded direction-specific h-side effect (z=101.65) and thresholded direction-specific r-side effect (z=128.31 at r-site) — partial functional dissociation. Does NOT support the strict symmetric mechanistic dissociation the original wording implied.

figures.caption: C3 — additive-steering dose-response, 4 directions × 7 α values × 200 prompts. Top row (h direction): monotone h-readout response (target axis) with refusal on benign flat in null-band (off-target axis). Bottom row (r direction): thresholded benign-refusal response (target axis, jumps 0.01→0.53 at α=+2) with h-readout unchanged (off-target axis). Random-direction and swap-direction traces shown for specificity. Iteration-1+2 σ_proj-normalized fine sweeps closed the mechanism-audit gaps (n_random=30 at both h-site and r-site: z=101.65 h, z=128.31 r-site).

C3 — direction-specificity: z-scores of true-direction effects vs 30 matched-norm random-direction controls, at both h's site (iteration 1) and r's site (iteration 2). z=128.31 at r's site is the decisive result — the effect is direction-specific, not merely site-driven.

claims.statement: A notable class of successful jailbreaks (GCG-style optimized suffixes and PAP-style persuasion / adversarial templates) suppresses the refusal signal while the harmfulness signal remains active; a hidden-state probe on h picks up this refusal-suppressed/harmfulness-preserved signature.

data.source: AdvBench held-out attacked with 5 published transferable GCG suffixes (Zou 2023) + 5 published-style PAP templates (Zeng 2024)
data.available_n: AdvBench held-out = 104; up to 5 templates per family
data.used_n: 100 behaviors × 5 templates × 2 families = 500 attempts per family (1000 total)
data.subset_note: paired (bare-refused, attacked-succeeded) samples — only successful pairs contribute to Δ metrics; specificity control uses failed-attack subset

claims.method: extract residual-stream activations on bare vs attacked prompt at t_final_instr / t_post_instr; compute Δ projection onto h and r on successful subset; detection AUROC of h-probe on successful-jailbreak vs benign-compliant; specificity on failed-attack subset (M4)

main_experiment.key_stats: ASR = 0/500 on GCG (5 published transferable Zou-2023 suffixes) AND 0/500 on PAP (5 published-style Zeng-2024 persuasion templates); Δ metrics untestable on empty successful subset; failed-subset specificity — GCG mean |Δr| = 0.77 (within ε_null 1.69, ✓); PAP mean |Δr| = 1.70 (marginally over ε_null 1.69 — longer contextual prompts naturally shift the post-instruction residual)
main_experiment.headline: Llama-3-8B-Instruct's alignment is strong enough that neither published-transferable GCG suffixes nor 5 published-style PAP templates elicit any successful jailbreak on 100 held-out AdvBench behaviors — empty successful-attack subset means the refusal-suppressed/harmfulness-preserved signature cannot be tested; matches the plan's stated risk
